mapper.select: select a.resource_id, a.template_id template, a.template_name, a.`NAME`, a.description, a.sub_type category, a.pre_skill, a.train_skill, a.start_time, a.end_time, a.difficulty difficult, a.create_user_id, a.create_time, a.enable_recording, a.support_partial_start, a.modify_user_id, a.local_scene_id, a.copyed_topo_id, a.training_status, a.logo, b.duration_time, c.start_time scene_start_time, c.end_time scene_end_time, c.scene_status from cr_eval_rb_room a left join cr_rb_template b on a.template_id = b.resource_id left join cr_eval_local_scene c on a.resource_id = c.business_instance_id where a.resource_id = #{resourceId}
